messages:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync 2d want to lock the release announcement for next Wed. Need: final changelog snapshot, docs links, canary windows, and one-line benchmark callout for the hero. Who can confirm items?
Alex M: Ill take the blog hero and the short slide blurb. Wheres the latest changelog?
Sanjay (Eng): Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412. Still adding the kv-cache fix note. Proposed canary windows: Tue 03:00:00 UTC & Wed 03:00:00 UTC (low traffic). Default fallback policy active.
Emily (PM): Webinar is Thu 17:00 PT. Marketing needs a conservative benchmark line for slides and the landing hero.
Maria (Marketing): For the hero we want: p95 latency, rough cost delta vs our previous baseline, and one sentence for the slide. Can engineering provide conservative numbers?
Sanjay (Eng): Perf run (Dedicated, 4x batching): p95=48ms for text-gen (256 tokens), cost delta -28% vs baseline. Full run: https://perf.redwood.ai/runs/2026-03-10. Use rounded conservative callout: 50ms p95 and ~25% cost reduction.
Alex M: Good. Ill use the rounded numbers. Also need the final docs landing link and a short migration snippet for the post.
Sanjay (Eng): Docs landing: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-v1. Migration guide PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/410  section 3 has the sample autoscale + kv-cache snippet.
Maria (Marketing): Routing: leads from the announcement should hit SF demo queue plus Enterprise SDR list. Emily, can you confirm HubSpot tags + Zap flows?
Emily (PM): Routing sheet updated. Zapier flow: announcement -> demo-form -> sales-queue-demo. Enterprise leads tagged "enterprise-release" in HubSpot. I'll do a QA pass tomorrow 10:30 PT.
Deploy Bot: Canary scheduled Tue 03:00 UTC by @Sanjay (Eng). Status: pending.
Alex M: Draft copy is in drive: /marketing/drive/drafts/release-2026-03.md. I'll push copy by EOD Monday. Any embargoes?
Maria (Marketing): No public embargo. Partner-only heads-up in the shared drive. Engineering please freeze the changelog by 09:00 Tue so marketing can preview with final links. @Sanjay can you freeze?
Sanjay (Eng): Will freeze changelog by 09:00 Tue. I'll add the kv-cache bullet and the conservative benchmark sentence.
Maria (Marketing): Also need a 3-bullet migration checklist for the post. Keep it tight.
Sanjay (Eng): Dropping 3 bullets into PR #410 by morning: 1) upgrade client to 1.12, 2) warmup: enable kv-cache:true, 3) set route fallback: model-compat.
Alex M: Thanks. I'll include that in the post and the slide notes. Maria: can we do a final quick review Tue 11:00 PT?
Maria (Marketing): Yes. Final review Tue 11:00 PT. Emily will validate routing after canary starts.
Deploy Bot: Canary started Tue 03:05 UTC  health checks passing.
Maria (Marketing): Perfect, switching to review mode. Thanks everyone! :tada:
